description: This file defines an abstract class 'LeaveAllocate' within the 'OrangeHRM\Leave\Event' namespace. The class extends an 'Event' base class and encapsulates data and methods related to leave allocation events, including leave request details, workflow state, and performing user. It provides mechanisms to access detailed leave requests and associated workflow and user data.

classes.name: LeaveAllocate
classes.description: An abstract class representing leave allocation events, holding leave request data, the workflow state, and the user performing the action.

methods.name: getDetailedLeaveRequest
methods.description: Returns a detailed leave request object, converting a simple leave request into a detailed version if necessary and fetching leave data.

methods.name: getWorkflow
methods.description: Returns the workflow state machine associated with the leave allocation event.

methods.name: getPerformer
methods.description: Returns the user who performed the leave allocation action.
